refnamediv.refpurpose: Checks whether a property can be written from a given scope

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
scope
The name of the class from which the property would be written, or &null; for the global scope, that is, code outside of any class. Use static::class to check from the scope of the calling code, if inside a class.
object
The object on which the property would be written. If &null;, only the declaration of the property is considered. Must be &null; for static properties.

&reftitle.notes;
If object is an uninitialized lazy object, calling this method on a readonly property may trigger its initialization.
